args.prompt: Continuous realistic two-second horizontal 16:9 night pirate battle on ONE old wooden vessel. Camera moves in from a two-shot of Silas, lean dark-haired pirate in soaked worn dark officer coat and red sash, fighting the same sturdy red-bearded tricorn pirate, to close combat with their rapier and cutlass tightly crossed. Both men's arms, hands, shoulders and faces genuinely move under the physical resistance of locked blades, muscles strain, blades scrape and shift. All around them other sailors of the SAME ship exchange sword blows, duck, stagger and fight continuously, never freezing. The ship pitches in violent storm surf, waves crash through railings, rain falls diagonally, rigging swings, torn sails snap and lanterns sway; one brief lightning flash illuminates a different patch of storm cloud and then vanishes. Water streaked with blood sloshes across old wooden planks. Coherent true cinematic physical character and world motion, no cuts, no second ship.
args.negative_prompt: slideshow, camera-only zoom, still characters, static background fight, frozen rain or waves, permanent lightning, any other vessel, second ship, duplicate protagonists, swapped faces, changing uniforms, deformed sword, extra hands, extra arms, glowing sword, daylight, graphic wounds, gore, text, watermark
